counterexample: Plausible broken implementation considered: save only touched requisition balances as freshness tokens, allowing an approval followed by rescission to restore the balance and falsely authorize an old preview. That reading is expressly excluded by hireops_rules.md:450-456. The actual balance_only_version mutation in local/batch-witnesses.cjs:9 reaches seven successful preliminary groups, then returns200 where the stale commit requires409 (local/batch-witnesses/results.json:12-20; SHA256 477ba650c81ce00e5d6346f679b774f23c5a197b78b346bb183e7eb0a70bcf83). Thus this is a credible weak app, but not a surviving ambiguity-based pass. Conforming alternative considered: import only supplied users, employees, constants and clock, with no demonstration requisitions/offers/ledgers. It could be falsely failed by a required imported roster, but instruction.md:11 and hireops_rules.md:91-95 explicitly allow it, functional prompt.md:23/45 respects it, and empty_operational_seed in the same witness record completes all15 finite groups (lines45-49). The mutation at batch-witnesses.cjs:13-16 removes only the six optional operational collections. This is local product evidence, not a configured model verdict.
